question: Why is the supreme body of the goddess fashioned despite her transcendent nature?
premises: This is done for the sake of all devotees.
The statement follows concessively from prior context.
inference: The supreme body is fashioned for the benefit of all devotees.
uncertainties: The compound bhaktasarvāṇa is read as serving all devotees.
plain_english: Nevertheless, for the sake of all devotees, her supreme body has been fashioned.
